A.name: Thumbnail_Game_03_Jefe_Jotunn_R15
A.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Edit the attached image (Reference 1). Keep everything else identical: composition, camera, framing, background, lighting, colors, Jotunn's design, size and reaching pose, the paladin's position, body angle and golden light aura. Change only the following. 1. Pose: the paladin swings the frost greatsword overhead with both hands toward Jotunn. 2. Paladin helmet: replace the current helmet with the exact helmet from Reference 2: a fully closed great helm, polished silver steel, gold trim on every edge, a vertical gold ridge down the center of the visor, a narrow horizontal eye slit and vertical breathing slits, one blue diamond gem on the forehead, a round gold rivet on each side, dark navy-blue side panels. The face is completely hidden behind the visor. Nothing on top of the helmet: no horns, no wings, no crest, no plume. 3. Paladin armor: match References 3, 4 and 5 exactly: navy-blue undersuit; silver chest plate with gold trim, a gold vertical spine and a single blue diamond gem at the collar; layered silver shoulder pauldrons with gold edges and navy inlays; silver plate gauntlets with gold knuckle plates. Same armor colors and gem placement as the references, no extra ornaments. 4. Sword: keep the frost greatsword exactly as Reference 6: long crystalline ice-blue blade, dark silver spiked guard, violet diamond gems, long black wrapped grip, spiked pommel with a violet gem. It is a two-handed weapon: both block hands grip the long black handle, one above the other. 5. Keep the blocky Roblox R15 avatar body: square torso, rectangular arms and legs, block hands. Output: horizontal 16:9, exactly 1920x1080. Keep the bottom-left corner dark and empty for a logo. No text, no letters, no logo, no UI, no watermark.
